CustomField.description: The most of any org limit that AI Assist may take the org to. When set and lower than the paused percentage it replaces it, which leaves the rest of every limit for the org's own processes. Blank means only the paused percentage applies.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: AI Assist never takes the org above this percentage of a limit. Blank: only the paused percentage applies.
CustomField.label: Org Limit Maximum Share Percent
